s001: Hazel's flank rises and falls slowly as she sleeps; the vet breathes gently, eyes closed, the lamp glow steady. Smooth, very slow cinematic push-in toward the bed.
s002: Hazel breathes slowly in deep sleep, one ear gives a tiny twitch, whiskers quiver; everything else stays still. Smooth slow cinematic push-in on her face.
s003: The vet's wide eyes blink once and dart down to the scaler; her gloved hand trembles slightly, the mask stays still. Smooth slow cinematic push-in toward her eyes.

s006: The vet's hand strokes slowly along Hazel's back, fur parting softly; Hazel breathes deeply, ears relaxed, eyes stay closed. Smooth slow cinematic lateral drift following the hand.
s007: The vet keeps looking down, then slowly lifts her gaze toward the window, fingers tapping once on the worktop, mouth closed. Smooth slow cinematic push-in.
s008: Hazel's contented smile deepens; she blinks slowly and tilts her head a little into the warm light, whiskers twitching. Smooth slow cinematic push-in on her face.

s014: Hazel's mouth stays open, her tongue shifting slightly, gums glistening; the teeth stay still and sharp. Smooth slow cinematic push-in along the back teeth.

s049: Hazel's mouth stays open, gums glistening, the tartar seeming to creep slightly thicker along the teeth. Smooth slow cinematic lateral track across the rows of teeth.

s056: The vet's eyes stay wide and frozen with fear, unblinking, the mask still. Smooth slow cinematic push-in, very close on her eyes.
s057: The vet exhales slowly, eyes closed, shoulders dropping, hands resting on Hazel; Hazel's chest rises gently as the monitor pulses steadily. Smooth slow cinematic push-in.
s058: The vet breathes slowly in her sleep, curled on the floor; beside her the kennel stays quiet and still. Smooth slow cinematic dolly toward the kennel.

s060: The vet's fingers curl gently around the bars; Hazel blinks slowly and leans forward to sniff them. Smooth slow cinematic push-in between them.

s067: Hazel eats steadily from the bowl, chewing, ears twitching, tail swaying; the vet smiles down warmly, mouth closed. Smooth slow cinematic pull-back.

s073: Hazel keeps her eyes closed happily and licks her lips, ears relaxed; the vet leans a little closer, smiling, mouth closed. Smooth slow cinematic push-in.

s078: Hazel blinks slowly, content, whiskers twitching, her head tilting slightly into the warm light. Smooth slow cinematic push-in on her face.
s079: The vet breathes slowly in peaceful sleep; Hazel rises and falls on her chest, one ear twitching. Smooth slow cinematic overhead move lowering toward them.
s080: The vet's fingers stroke Hazel's fur gently, her sleeping smile deepening, mouth closed; Hazel breathes slowly. Smooth slow cinematic push-in.

s085: The tub stays perfectly still, its label sharp and readable; morning light glows softly brighter across the worktop. Smooth, very slow cinematic push-in on the tub.
